entry.decision: Continue the experiment under the existing sport-specific priors. New completed games can update future fitted team ratings. Daily wins and losses do not trigger parameter changes. Each sport and formula retains its own $500 starting-bankroll simulation and stakes of 2% of the Eastern day’s opening balance; balances and returns are never pooled.
